description: Task 018 legacy ABI 2 conformance from a separately compiled C consumer on macOS. Real binary enumeration/execution and negative controls are required; Rust-only and native-v1 consumers are separate. Other host layouts and caller synchronization remain separate obligations.

cases.expected: The authoritative legacy C header and linked Rust library preserve layouts, ownership, invalid-input atomicity, prediction exclusion, frozen bytes and history/save revision behavior
